The '''Well-Done Bantha''' was a fine-dining establishment on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], specializing in steaks and exotic dishes from all over the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Cloud Cover" />

The [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Spensor Kluub]] used a private booth at the Bantha as his office.<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
